properties.name: name
properties.description:
Form field name. Without it the slider still works, it just submits
nothing — same as a native input with no `name`.

properties.name: nameStart
properties.description:
Range mode submits TWO values, which one name cannot express. By default
both go under `name` (read them with `formData.getAll(name)`); set these to
give each end its own key. Ignored outside `range`.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Single-thumb layout: `standard` fills from min; `centered` fills from range midpoint to value.

properties.name: stops
properties.description: Stop / tick marks at each step.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Expressive size (default XS per MD3 spec)

properties.name: fullHeight
properties.description:
Make a **vertical** slider fill its parent's block size (responsive height)
instead of the fixed `--md-slider-track-length`. The parent needs a definite
height; otherwise it falls back to the track-length floor so it never
collapses. (Horizontal sliders are already full-width by default.)

properties.name: insetIcon
properties.description: Standard slider only: inset icon area (use `icon` or `inset-icon` slot)

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Material Symbols name when `inset-icon` and no slotted icon

properties.name: ariaLabelStart
properties.description:
Accessible label for the range-start thumb (becomes the thumb input's
`aria-label`; overrides `aria-label`). NB: a plain (non-`aria-`) attribute
name — `aria-label-start` is not a valid ARIA attribute and would just
pollute the host with an invalid `aria-*`.

properties.name: ariaLabelEnd
properties.description: Accessible label for the range-end thumb (becomes the thumb input's `aria-label`).

properties.name: valueText
properties.description: Human-readable text alternative for the current value (single slider). Mapped to `aria-valuetext`.

properties.name: valueStartText
properties.description: Human-readable text for the range-start value. Mapped to `aria-valuetext` on the start thumb.

properties.name: valueEndText
properties.description: Human-readable text for the range-end value. Mapped to `aria-valuetext` on the end thumb.

properties.name: controlled
properties.description:
When `true`, the slider never mutates `value` / `valueStart` / `valueEnd` on user interaction.
Listen to `mdInput` (continuous) and `mdChange` (committed) events and write the props back yourself.
During a drag gesture the slider uses internal live state for smooth visuals.

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

slots.name: inset-icon
slots.description: — Custom icon (standard slider only; use with inset-icon)

cssProperties.name: --md-slider-value-indicator-reserve
cssProperties.description: Space reserved for a persistent value indicator (block-start horizontal, inline-end vertical)

cssProperties.name: --md-slider-inset-icon-active-color
cssProperties.description: Inset icon color when over the active track segment

attributes.name: class
attributes.value:
{
          'md-slider': true,
          [`md-slider--size-${this.size}`]: true,
          'md-slider--vertical': vertical,
          'md-slider--horizontal': !vertical,
          'md-slider--centered': this.isCentered,
          'md-slider--range': this.range,
          'md-slider--stops': this.showStops,
          'md-slider--inset': insetArea,
          'md-slider--disabled': this.disabled,
        }

name: Slider
description: Choose a value, or a range, along a continuum. Horizontal or vertical, single or two-thumb range, discrete steps with tick marks, value indicators, and an optional inset icon that travels with the handle.

notes: Dedicated native slider: standard / centered / range, five sizes, stops, value indicator, inset icon (Material Symbols from icon), vertical orientation, keyboard, pointer and touch input with the source events and order, the stylesheet transitions; hooks through AWCSliderAppearance.
Host property changes follow the Stencil watchers: value / valueStart / valueEnd changes clear a live drag value, min / max changes re-clamp (written back to the node).
The inset-icon slot renders its content in the inset box instead of the icon glyph (centred, inset-size font, the inset colour inherited), under the track mask (R6-04).

Parts: typed part appearances (.awcSliderPartAppearance(_:part:) / AWCSliderPartAppearanceScope) with the source part semantics — surface opacity, track corner shape, track-active / track-inactive colour, size from the track edge and corner shape, thumb-knob colour and size, value-indicator colour / font / padding / shape, inset colour (Mac Chrome ::part cases, paint-extra2).

macOS SwiftUI, the iOS simulator and the Android emulator are verified against Chrome 153: paint, pointer / keyboard / touch replays with events, motion per frame (plain and reduced motion), lifecycle (runtime property changes through the Stencil watchers, form reset), RTL.
